name: CyberLove
source:
You've lived here for a few weeks. Your apartment isn't huge and the surroundings aren't perfect, but that's basically true for all housing in Hikari. You work at a small store a few blocks away, selling various art products and such. The pay isn't horrible, and actually… it's pretty good for a job here.

Hikari no machi, the city of light. It's a wonder that you found a place here, it's quite populated. Although, that does mean a lot of crime takes place. Mostly on the north side of the city, though. You're lucky you live in the eastern district. Although, that might not be far enough.

CyberLove is an 18+ yandere visual novel set in a futuristic city. You are just trying to live a normal(ish) life, but a certain brunette has found quite an interest in you. And he'll do anything to have you.

[From [url=https://keres-ene.itch.io/cyberlove]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在这里住了几个星期。公寓不大，周边环境也算不上理想，不过光城的住宅基本都是如此。你在几个街区外的一家小商店工作，售卖各种美术用品之类的东西。工资还过得去，事实上……在这里，这份工作的待遇已经相当不错了。

Hikari no machi，光之城。这里人口密集，你能找到住处着实不容易。不过，人多也意味着犯罪频发。好在大多集中于城北。你住在东区，算是幸运。只是，这点距离也许还不够。

《CyberLove》是一部设定在未来都市的18岁以上病娇题材视觉小说。你只想过上大致平凡的生活，某个棕发男人却对你产生了浓厚兴趣。为了得到你，他什么都做得出来。

[摘自[url=https://keres-ene.itch.io/cyberlove]Itch.io[/url]]
